full_program.recipe: Copy the ordinary composed PROGRAM with canonical gameplay_sources.read() projections, and place matching engine shared headers in resource/shared next to the isolated probe. Rename the single seadogs.c void Main() to void GameMainNotExecuted(); include seadogs.c in cases.c. The probe driver invokes only Run, never game initialization. No RESOURCE scene or SAVE is copied.
